summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical compatibility and cannot auto-promote; v2 assigns candidates roles: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; separate sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; adapter controls transport, paging, continuation, coverage, truncation; ready receipts use immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/ with validated atomic current pointer; consumers resolve pointer only; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derived from changed-set and path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active attempts; committed evidence deletion requires maintainer approval and non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers before 8-18 creates new current receipt; historical current directories remain immutable; ADR extends 0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only v1 selection/current-resolution practices; does not create lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap
